title: How AI Built a Million Dollar App
full_monologue: **Imagine building a million-dollar app with just AI.** It started with a simple idea and a powerful tool. This developer used AI to generate features, automate testing, and even write code. The result? A fully functional app in weeks, not months. The app solved a real problem and scaled fast. Now, it’s a million-dollar success. Want to know how you can do the same? Let me know in the comments.
